# We have all habit log note IDs: 1971-1993. Let's fetch all their contents and extract the ate_homemade_meals status.
habit_note_ids = list(range(1971, 1994))
habit_data = []
for nid in habit_note_ids:
    note = apis.simple_note.show_note(access_token=access_token, note_id=nid)
    # Extract date from title: "Habit Log -- YYYY-MM-DD"
    date_str = note['title'].split('-- ')[1].strip()
    # Extract ate_homemade_meals value from content
    content = note['content']
    # Find line starting with "ate_homemade_meals:"
    for line in content.split('\n'):
        if line.startswith('ate_homemade_meals:'):
            value = line.split(':')[1].strip()
            habit_data.append({'date': date_str, 'ate_homemade_meals': value})
            break
print(habit_data)
